description: Who is volunteering when. Lists upcoming shifts with date/time, schedule, whether that date is still on, and the rostered volunteers' names. Omit `schedule_id` to cover EVERY active schedule in one call (best for questions like "who is on this Sunday?": pass from and to as that same date). A bare "yyyy-MM-dd" `to` includes that whole day. Requires the `read` scope.

from.description: Start of the range: "yyyy-MM-dd" (account timezone) or a full ISO 8601 datetime. Defaults to now.

schedule_id.description: Limit to one schedule (id from list_schedules). Omit to include all active schedules.

to.description: End of the range, same formats as `from`; a bare date includes that whole day. Defaults to 90 days from now.

name: get_upcoming_shifts
title: Get upcoming shifts
